message: applied: Standard held at $11 a month: $0.28 so far this month. Moved this month: 156,268 events to Flex, about $0.01 a month of Flex storage at $0.05 per million (Flex compute is unpriced and left out), $0.27 at the Standard rate. The Receiver's other services may send 20,579 events an hour to Standard against 35,945 now: each statement keeps up to 983 an hour, and the noisiest move to Flex first. A service the run has not seen gets the same level and the median service's 766 an hour until the next run, which takes any overshoot back from the rest of the month.
